draft.knownFor: The animated 2269 Alice robot voiced by Nichelle Nichols in Once Upon a Planet (1973).
draft.reveal: The frozen Alice source separates two performances. Marcia Brown played the 2267 live-action Alice in Shore Leave, while Nichelle Nichols voiced the 2269 animated Alice in Once Upon a Planet. This record is limited to Nichols’s animated voice performance. The exact 2269 character still and a separately sourced licensed Nichols portrait are retained; physical performance, animation labor, character design, voice direction, vocal processing, sound, transformation measurement, and every other unsupported maker function remain unresolved.

references.label: The Alice source identifies Nichelle Nichols as the voice of the 2269 animated Alice and separates Marcia Brown’s live-action performance
Once Upon a Planet is the 1973 animated episode featuring Alice’s 2269 appearance
